title: SPGR Usage Window v1
description: ~/.springer/usage/<provider>.json, one per provider account. Written by the daemon, read before claiming a ready unit.

used_fraction.description: From the provider's usage signal. Null while no signal has been read.

own_tokens.description: The daemon's own count for the window, a cross-check on used_fraction.

dispatch_rate.description: The concurrency the scheduler derived. Zero parks the scheduler until resets_at.
